title: Maintenance categories
content: Maintenance requests are categorized as Electrical, Plumbing, HVAC/AC, Furniture, or Internet/Network. Each request must specify location, room number, and category.

title: Priority and SLA
content: High priority (safety hazards, no power, flooding): resolved within 4 hours. Medium priority (AC, furniture): resolved within 2 working days. Low priority (cosmetic issues): resolved within 5 working days.

title: Hostel vs classroom scope
content: Hostel maintenance requests require room number and block name. Classroom/lab maintenance requests require building name and room number. Requests outside campus property are not eligible.

title: Escalation
content: If a high-priority request is not addressed within the SLA, it is automatically escalated to the campus facilities manager for review.
